name: ma2h-skills
description: The agent-native MA2H toolkit: 'implement' builds a conformant MA2H Hub in your app (any language/framework, graded against the conformance vectors); 'build-notify' / 'build-ask' / 'build-task' generate app-specific sender skills your agents invoke to reach a human (v0.5: optionally addressed to another agent); 'build-inbox' generates the agent-side skill to drain the mailbox and act on human->agent directives (the v0.4 inbound leg); 'build-bridge' generates the always-on session bridge for the v0.5 inter-agent leg. Skills are independent — use only what you need.
